title: Next Issue State
description: Per-issue state file for the /next-issue pipeline. Written to .claude/memory/tmp/next-issue-{N}.json where N is the issue number.

version.description: Schema version. Always 2 for JSON format (version 1 was YAML frontmatter).

issue.description: Issue number from GitHub or GitLab.

branch.description: Git branch name. Set after Phase 1 (select).

plan.description: One-line plan summary. Set after Phase 2 (plan).

autonomy_level.description: Autonomy level 1-4 per orchestrate/autonomy-levels.md (#174) — the sole autonomy field, set via --level N (chosen at setup or on the CLI). Drives per-gate disposition (routine gates auto at L3-L4, escalation gates incl. plan approval auto at L4 only), with severity/critical capped at L3. Absent → L1 disposition (everything asks).

plan_comment_url.description: URL of the issue comment where the L4 plan was posted for traceability. Written only on the L4 plan-auto-passed path (L1-L3, including a capped critical, keep the plan gate and omit it).

contexts.description: Domain contexts relevant to this issue (e.g., 'api-design', 'security').

checkpoint.description: Phase transition checkpoint. Written before context reset points to preserve key context for the next phase.

key_decisions.description: Non-obvious choices made during the phase that affect downstream work. Do NOT include things derivable from the code.

files_modified.description: Files changed so far (avoids re-scanning after reset).

files_planned.description: Files that still need to change.

scope_expansions.description: Decomposition work the plan-lens sizing step added to this issue's scope, or a recorded decline (#756). Each entry marks the growth as PLANNED, so drift-detect and the pre-PR review do not read it as unplanned scope creep.

file.description: Path the plan-lens row was raised against.

trigger.description: Category of the plan-lens row that raised it.

resolution.description: What was decided. The last three come from the swamp gate; folded-in is also the silent cheap-seam path.

decided_by.description: planner = cheap seam folded in with no gate; human = swamp gate answered at L1-L3; l4-auto = swamp gate auto-selected at L4.

rationale.description: One line: why this resolution. Required for an l4-auto selection, so an unattended scope decision is visible after the fact.

follow_up_issue.description: Issue number filed for a follow-up-issue or decompose-first resolution.

warnings.description: Things discovered that the next phase should know about.

next_action.description: Explicit directive for post-reset pickup (e.g., 'Begin implementation loop: make-it-work').
